description: Regression cases for the remaining identification failures (marriage certificates, PAN actions, lower-case 'uk', a certificate of no named kind, a citizen working abroad, colloquial and abbreviated wording), as variants of each, plus the categories the brief asks for: Indian states, foreign jurisdictions, similar documents and services, different actions for one document, ambiguous certificate requests, overseas citizens and voters, abbreviations and lower case, colloquial wording and out-of-scope questions. Written from the stored pages before the fixes, and kept apart from the existing fixtures, whose expectations are unchanged. Identification only ("answer": null): the expected page, no match ([null]), or a request to say which document ("clarification": true). 'content/renewal' is not used: it also matches renewal-of-rc.
